slots.author: CoinDesk

slots.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Brian Armstrong says Coinbase is building payment tools for AI agents and believes bitcoin has hit bottom despite the selloff.

slots.title: U.S. judge says Ethereum has ‘no terms of use,’ clears MIT brothers of $25 million fraud
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: A federal judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno, ruling that their 2023 trade against Ethereum trading bots involved no lie that anyone relied on, and closing the U.S. government’s first criminal case over the practice known as MEV.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
